items.prompt: On a map, a church lies in the square whose bottom-left corner is at easting 47 and northing 66. It is seven-tenths of the way across the square to the east and two-tenths of the way up. Give its six-figure grid reference.
items.canonical_answer: Working: easting 47 and seven-tenths gives 477; northing 66 and two-tenths gives 662. The answer is 477662.
marking_guidance: Working: eastings first (477), then northings (662) - the method step.
Answer: the final six-figure reference 477662; 662477 reverses the order and earns nothing.
Units: a grid reference has no unit; it is six figures.
items.provenance: Authored for the 0460 structural exemplar from the topic 4 claim ledger.

items.prompt: On a map of scale 1:50 000, a road from the school to the bridge measures 4.6 cm along its bends. Calculate the distance along the road in kilometres.
items.canonical_answer: Working: 1 cm on the map is 0.5 km on the ground, so 4.6 × 0.5 = 2.3. The road is 2.3 km long.
marking_guidance: Working: the scale converted, 1 cm to 0.5 km - the method step.
Units: kilometres; the straight-line distance would be shorter and is not what was asked.
items.provenance: Authored for the 0460 structural exemplar from the topic 4 claim ledger.

items.prompt: Asked for the compass direction of the quarry from the church, a learner writes "135°". State the error.
items.canonical_answer: The learner has given a bearing when a compass direction was asked. The answer should be a point of the compass: 135° is south-east.
marking_guidance: 1 mark: the confusion named - a bearing given instead of a compass direction, which is not the same thing.
items.provenance: Authored for the 0460 structural exemplar from the topic 4 claim ledger.

items.prompt:
This table describes part of a map; each cell is one grid square.

| northing \ easting | 46 | 47 | 48 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 66 | forest, spot height 212 m | village of Kolwe, church | river, bridge |
| 65 | farm, track | main road junction in the centre of the square | river |
| 64 | school | quarry | marsh |

Identify the feature in square 4764.
items.canonical_answer: Reading the table: easting 47 is the middle column and northing 64 the bottom row, so square 4764 shows the quarry.
marking_guidance: Read the table: easting 47 (column) and northing 64 (row), eastings first - so the value is the quarry.
items.provenance: Authored for the 0460 structural exemplar from the topic 4 claim ledger.

items.prompt:
This table describes part of a 1:50 000 map; each cell is one grid square, with north at the top.

| northing \ easting | 46 | 47 | 48 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 66 | forest, spot height 212 m | village of Kolwe, church | river, bridge |
| 65 | farm, track | main road junction in the centre of the square | river |
| 64 | school | quarry | marsh |

(a) Identify the feature in square 4864. [1]
(b) Give the four-figure grid reference of the square with the village of Kolwe. [1]
(c) State the compass direction of the quarry from the forest. [1]
(d) The road junction is at the centre of its square. Give its six-figure grid reference. [1]
(e) On the map the track from the farm to the school measures 2.8 cm. Calculate its length in kilometres. [1]
items.canonical_answer:
(a) Marsh.
(b) 4766.
(c) The quarry (square 4764) is one square east and two squares south of the forest (square 4666), so it lies to the south-south-east.
(d) 475655: halfway across square 4765 in both directions.
(e) 2.8 × 0.5 = 1.4, so the track is 1.4 km long.
marking_guidance: Resource: every answer is read from the map table - 1 mark per part, 5 marks in all.
Figures and values: grid references with eastings first; the direction as a compass point, not a bearing; the distance in kilometres from the scale.
